recent.text: Here's an important stat for Pete DeBoer and #Isles: In games where the team loses a player(s) or goes 11/7 due to injuries, they are 5-1-0. DeBoer's bench management in those games has been stellar, along with buy-in from his players.
recent.author: Stefen Rosner

recent.text: If Stanley has to miss time, putting in a claim for Reilly makes complete sense. Not sure he makes it to 14th on waiver wire. George is certainly an option but NYI is carrying two extra D right now. Could accrue cap space if they don't recall anyone/add anyone.
